entries.title: II Chronicles 22:3
segments: Those parents who counsel their children to do wrong, are often the means of their destruction, temporal and eternal.

entries.title: II Chronicles 22:5
segments: Those who knowingly do wrong are not unfrequently given up of God to pursue such courses as involve themselves and their connections in irretrievable ruin.

entries.title: II Chronicles 22:10
segments:
Destroyed all the seed royal; that they might not disturb her in reigning over the people. 
 
The judgments of God upon the wicked, instead of being improved as a warning against sin, are sometimes made the occasion of greater transgressions, which bring down heavier divine judgments.
